spec_case: electricity/docs/spec/tools-adapters-plugins.md §7 case 22 (the redaction blanket, run against an http tool call)
description: An Authorization: Bearer sk-live-... header and a userinfo-bearing URL nested in the JSON body: meta.params_rendered shows ***REDACTED*** for the header and a userinfo-stripped (not wholesale-replaced) form for the embedded URL, in both engines -- the recorded request the mock server actually received still carries the real header and URL, exactly as Python's own redaction (display-only, never a what-gets-sent change) does.
